card.name: Modifier before range or level
card.fires_on: The noun or article right after "within the/these", "same", or "to a" that comes just before "range", "group" or "level". Seen with dose, target, age and acceptable.

modes.label: Dose or target before range
modes.description: A word like dose or target after "within the/these" that is about to be followed by "ranges".
modes.example: Individualize the dose for a patient within these<< dose>> ranges depending on serum ionized calcium level

modes.label: Article or modifier before level
modes.description: A word such as a, age or power that leads into a level, group or amount.
modes.example: in women 50 to 79 years of age receiving daily CE (0.625 mg)-alone compared to women in the same<< age>> group receiving placebo

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying "profile" or "profiles" as the next word.
